limitations: A greedy/random policy difference tests reward discrimination, not discrimination between material vectors or learning of human ratios.
No price-dependent search, trained values, teacher engine, human labels or mature runtime.
Random-midgame selection changes the play distribution; do not pool with existing frozen480game experiment or claim a faster equivalent experiment.
Opening failures are preserved; no resampling, seed change or result-dependent extension.
Shared seed draw streams diverge under different trajectories; not identical opponent actions.
The one-ply greedy uses lexical ties and automatic standard-Chess terminal authority; no SEE or weighted material prior.
Shorter games do not automatically identify long-range or promoted-piece relative values; only a future actual pilot can decide signal/cost.
